summary.name: Logic Pro
summary.one_liner: Logic Pro is Apple's music creation app for Mac and iPad, covering songwriting, beat-making, editing, and mixing.
use_cases: producing music on a Mac or iPad
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Logic Pro as a music creation app for Mac and iPad with features for songwriting, beat-making, editing, and mixing. It is part of Apple Creator Studio, a subscription bundle that also includes Final Cut Pro, Motion, Compressor, and MainStage. The page states that Logic Pro and MainStage help users produce, perform, and perfect music. It does not list specific technical features or instrument details in the text provided.
notable: Included in Apple Creator Studio subscription bundle
Supports songwriting, beat-making, editing, and mixing
Paired with MainStage for live performance
caveats: Logic Pro is offered within the Apple Creator Studio subscription; standalone pricing is not stated on the page text provided
Page text is mostly marketing; no detailed feature list or standalone price is given
